item.label: View All Seasons
item.property: Shows Kodi's All seasons entry in TV shows (videolibrary.showallitems).[CR][CR]OK toggles On / Off.

item.label: View All Albums
item.property: Shows Kodi's All albums entry in Music (musiclibrary.showallitems).[CR][CR]OK toggles On / Off.

item.label: Bezel Look Options
item.property: One button style for the whole skin: Main menu buttons and every list button change together (shared setting bz_at_hishape — same as Tuner LOOK bar shape).[CR][CR]OK cycles Square / Rounded / Pill / Underline / Outline.

control.label: [B]UP / DOWN[/B] pick[CR][B]LEFT / RIGHT[/B] change[CR][B]OK[/B] toggle / run[CR][B]BACK[/B] close (applies on close)

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_albumposter] ALBUM
item.property: Settings for album / poster. OK opens / closes this section.

item.label: Preset
item.property: Sets every album / poster setting at once: Default, Subtle, Mid, High or Extreme. Custom = you changed one by hand.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT cycles the presets.

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_al_glare] GLARE
item.property: Album glare: style, opacity, tint. OK opens / closes this group.

item.label: Glare style
item.property: The glare overlay on the album (music list and Now Playing).[CR][CR]Original = the BEZEL glare. G1-G6 = Diagonal, Twin bar, Top sheen, Spot, Vinyl arc, Glass edge.[CR][CR]Default: Original

item.label: Glare opacity
item.property: Strength of the album glare.[CR][CR]0% hides it.[CR][CR]Range: 0% to 100% Default: 75%

item.label: Glare tint
item.property: Colour of the album glare.[CR][CR]Default: White

item.label: Reset album glare
item.property: OK puts these settings back to their defaults.

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_al_shadow] SHADOW
item.property: Album shadow = cast ON the colour block / strip. Big album = the shadow AROUND the big album. OK opens / closes this group.

item.label: Cast shadow style
item.property: Style of the shadow the album casts ON the colour block. Current = the 2.7 shadow (unchanged). Soft = blurred edge. Long = reaches further into the block. Short = tight band at the block edge. Offset = dropped 70 px (light from above). Faint = same shape at 45%.[CR][CR]Range: Current to Faint Default: Current

item.label: Cast length
item.property: How far the shadow reaches into the colour block (on top of the style).[CR][CR]Range: 50% to 175% Default: 100%

item.label: Cast softness
item.property: Edge blur. Style = what the style uses (Soft style = Soft, others = Original).[CR][CR]Range: Style to Softer Default: Style

item.label: Cast opacity
item.property: How dark the cast shadow is. 0% = no cast shadow.[CR][CR]Range: 0% to 100% Default: 100%

item.label: Cast offset Y
item.property: Moves the cast shadow up (-) or down (+), on top of the style.[CR][CR]Range: -40 px to +100 px Default: 0 px

item.label: Cast offset X
item.property: Moves the cast shadow left (-, away from the art) or right (+, further over the block edge), on top of the style.[CR][CR]Range: -60 px to +60 px Default: 0 px

item.label: Cast shadow animated
item.property: ON = the shadow grows and fades with the sway (as now). OFF = a fixed shadow that only appears while the art sways.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it.

item.label: Big album shadow style
item.property: The shadow behind the big album while it sways (nothing playing).[CR][CR]Original = the BEZEL shadow (LOOK > Shadow texture / opacity). Soft, Hard, Contact and Glow use the size, opacity and shape below.[CR][CR]Default: Original

item.label: Big album shadow size
item.property: How far the shadow spreads (not used by Original).[CR][CR]Default: Medium

item.label: Big album shadow opacity
item.property: How dark the shadow is (not used by Original).[CR][CR]Default: 75%

item.label: Big album shadow shape
item.property: Outline of the shadow (not used by Original). Ellipse = a floor shadow under the album.[CR][CR]Default: Rounded

item.label: Reset album shadow
item.property: OK puts these settings back to their defaults.

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_al_dust] DUST
item.property: Album lit dust (same rows as DUST > ALBUM DUST). OK opens / closes this group.

item.label: Album lit dust
item.property: Lit dust (separate from ambient dust): specks that light up in the glare during the hold.[CR][CR]ON = lit specks through the glare. OFF = ambient dust only.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it.

item.label: Album lit dust Version
item.property: V1.0 = Dust 1.0 lit specks (default). V2.0 = the Dust 2.0 lit bake (album textures, own set).[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it.

item.label: Album lit dust opacity
item.property: Brightness of the lit dust in the light beam during the hold.[CR][CR]Higher = brighter lit specks on the glare side.[CR][CR]Range: 10% to 100% Default: 60%

item.label: Lit particle size
item.property: Size of the lit specks: the glare dust, the lit spin and the spin layer.[CR][CR]Small = finer specks. Large = bigger, softer specks.[CR][CR]Range: Small to Large Default: Small

item.label: Lit spin
item.property: A slow turning layer of lit specks inside the glare band of the poster / album. It follows the art sway.[CR][CR]ON = turning lit specks in the glare. OFF = drifting lit dust only.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default: ON

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_al_size] SIZE / ZOOM
item.property: Album size. OK opens / closes this group.

item.label: Big album
item.property: Size of the album in the music library while nothing plays.[CR][CR]ON = big album (900 px). OFF = standard album (600 px).[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default ON

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_al_sway] SWAY
item.property: Album sway hold (pause at the sway end) and flip speed; posters have their own hold under POSTER > SWAY. OK opens / closes this group.

item.label: Short sway
item.property: Use the short sway motion on the album art instead of the long one (also used by the small Now Playing art).[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default: Off

item.label: Album hold (-13)
item.property: The pause at the -13 tilt in the middle of the album sway. The Long sway path itself is fixed.[CR][CR]Higher = a longer hold at -13 (and a longer lit-dust moment). Lower = the art barely stops.[CR][CR]Range: 1 s to 8 s Default: 4 s

item.label: Flip speed
item.property: Speed of the album art flip when it changes.[CR][CR]Higher = quicker flip. Lower = a slower turn.[CR][CR]Range: 1x to 3x Default: 0.7x

item.label: Reset album
item.property: OK puts these settings back to their defaults.

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_posterglare] POSTER
item.property: Settings for posters: glare, cast shadow and sway. OK opens / closes this section.

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_p_glare] GLARE
item.property: Poster glare: style, opacity, tint. OK opens / closes this group.

item.label: Glare style
item.property: The glare overlay on movie / TV posters. Set apart from the album glare.[CR][CR]Original = the BEZEL glare. G1-G6 = Diagonal, Twin bar, Top sheen, Spot, Vinyl arc, Glass edge.[CR][CR]Default: Original

item.label: Glare opacity
item.property: Strength of the poster glare.[CR][CR]0% hides it.[CR][CR]Range: 0% to 100% Default: 75%

item.label: Glare tint
item.property: Colour of the poster glare.[CR][CR]Default: White

item.label: Reset poster glare
item.property: OK puts these settings back to their defaults.

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_p_shadow] SHADOW
item.property: Cast shadow the poster throws on the colour block. OK opens / closes this group.

item.label: Cast shadow style
item.property: Style of the shadow the poster casts ON the colour block. Current = straight soft wedge. Hard = crisp edge, no blur. Floor = drops to the floor, short. Glow = even halo all round. Fade = long fade, tapers to a point. Contact = thin tight rim only. Cast stays within poster height.[CR][CR]Range: Current to Contact Default: Current

item.label: Cast length
item.property: How far the shadow reaches into the colour block (on top of the style).[CR][CR]Range: 50% to 175% Default: 100%

item.label: Cast softness
item.property: Edge blur. Style = what the style uses (Soft style = Soft, others = Original).[CR][CR]Range: Style to Softer Default: Style

item.label: Cast opacity
item.property: How dark the cast shadow is. 0% = no cast shadow.[CR][CR]Range: 0% to 100% Default: 60%

item.label: Cast offset Y
item.property: Moves the cast shadow up (-) or down (+), on top of the style.[CR][CR]Range: -40 px to +100 px Default: 0 px

item.label: Cast offset X
item.property: Moves the cast shadow left (-, away from the art) or right (+, further over the block edge), on top of the style.[CR][CR]Range: -60 px to +60 px Default: 0 px

item.label: Cast shadow animated
item.property: ON = the shadow grows and fades with the sway (as now). OFF = a fixed shadow that only appears while the art sways.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it.

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_p_sway] SWAY
item.property: Poster sway hold (pause at the -13 / +13 ends). The Long sway itself is not changed. OK opens / closes this group.

item.label: Poster hold
item.property: Poster sway hold: the pause at each end of the poster swing (also the lit dust moment on posters).[CR][CR]Higher = a longer hold.[CR][CR]Range: 0.5 s to 10 s Default: 4 s

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_list] LIST
item.property: Settings for list. OK opens / closes this section.

item.label: Preset
item.property: Sets every list setting at once: Default, Subtle, Mid, High or Extreme. Custom = you changed one by hand.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT cycles the presets.

item.label: Title scroll
item.property: Scroll speed of long titles that do not fit their row.[CR][CR]Higher = text runs faster. Lower = easier to read while it moves.[CR][CR]Range: 30 px/s to 140 px/s Default: 60 px/s

item.label: Row scroll speed
item.property: How fast the list moves from row to row.[CR][CR]Higher = snappier scrolling. Lower = a slow glide (slide lines stay linear).[CR][CR]Range: 1x to 3x Default: 0.7x

item.label: Row softness
item.property: Easing curve of the row scroll.[CR][CR]Linear is even; cubic, circle and back ease in more softly or overshoot a touch.[CR][CR]Range: linear to back Default: cubic

item.label: Fanart fade
item.property: Cross-fade time between fanart backgrounds.[CR][CR]Higher = a slow dissolve. 0 = instant cut.[CR][CR]Range: 0 ms to 800 ms Default: 200 ms

item.label: Section list anim
item.property: How section list rows (list 60) appear when a folder opens.[CR][CR]Cascade = rows drop in one after another. Pop-in = all rows pop in together.[CR][CR]Bar style stays universal. LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default: Cascade

item.label: Cascade speed
item.property: Speed of the cascading rows when a list opens.[CR][CR]Higher = rows land faster.[CR][CR]Range: 1x to 3x Default: 1x

item.label: Cascade stagger
item.property: Delay between each cascading row.[CR][CR]Higher = a longer waterfall. 0 = all rows at once.[CR][CR]Range: 0 ms to 120 ms Default: 60 ms

item.label: Reset list
item.property: OK puts these settings back to their defaults.

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_warm20] WARM 2.0
item.property: WARM 2.0 artwork lane behind the Main menu: album art during music playback and the A/B fade length. OK opens / closes this section.

item.label: Album art during music
item.property: On = while music is playing and the Main menu is open, the poster lane (poster, cast shadow, frame, glare and LOOK) is hidden and the playing album art shows in that slot. The fanart stage is not changed.[CR][CR]Off = posters show normally even while music plays. The change applies at once; the sway keeps running.[CR][CR]LEFT = Off RIGHT = On Default: On

item.label: Startup splash
item.property: Controls only the startup splash IMAGE. Warm-caching of Music, Movies and TV always runs on startup either way.[CR][CR]On = approved warm-gate splash: first paint solid black with the pulsing Bezel logo, credit at 50%, version fade-in, fade-out when all three lists are warm or at the 5 s cap.[CR][CR]Off = no splash visuals; the skin goes straight to normal content while the three lists warm silently in the background. Applies on next Kodi start.[CR][CR]LEFT = Off RIGHT = On Default: On

item.label: A/B fade length
item.property: The slider sets the crossfade duration between artwork sides, default 1500 milliseconds. Lower values blend longer and hide load delays but can feel sluggish; higher values swap faster but slow-loading posters may pop before the fade catches them.[CR][CR]LEFT = longer blend (up to 2500 ms) RIGHT = faster swap (down to 800 ms)[CR]Steps: 2500 / 2000 / 1800 / 1500 / 1200 / 1000 / 800 ms Default: 1500 ms

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_mainmenu] MAIN MENU
item.property: Settings for the Main menu and the slide menu. OK opens / closes this section.

item.label: Strip colour
item.property: Colour of the Main menu strip.[CR][CR]Same setting as LOOK › Colour Block › Colour - changing one changes both.[CR][CR]Range: BEZEL blue to Teal Default: BEZEL blue

item.label: Strip opacity
item.property: Opacity of the Main menu colour strip.[CR][CR]Range: 10% to 100% Default: 50%

item.label: Glow style
item.property: Look of the glow behind the Main menu strip. Current = the original soft strip-coloured glow.[CR][CR]A F H J K N take the strip colour. B C D E G I L M O P keep their own film colours.[CR][CR]Options: Current, A to P Default: B Hex ghosts

item.label: Glow brightness
item.property: Brightness (opacity) of the soft glow behind the colour strip.[CR][CR]Range: 20% to 100% Default: B Hex ghosts

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_warmsys] WARM SYSTEM
item.property: The systems that load the section behind the Main menu: warm delay, section fade, art crossfade, dim level and the MM debug tools. OK opens / closes this group.

item.label: Background warm delay
item.property: How long the Main menu strip must sit still on a row before that section loads behind the menu. Higher = wait until parked; lower = snappier swaps.[CR][CR]Range: 0.2 s to 2.0 s Default: 0.2 s

item.label: Section fade
item.property: How long the section behind the Main menu fades out and back in when a new section warms under the menu. Off = instant swap.[CR][CR]Range: Off to 1.0 s Default: B Hex ghosts

item.label: Section fade depth
item.property: How far the held fanart / poster dips while a new section warms under the Main menu.[CR][CR]Keep = full fade out (current). Lighter = dips to about half, art stays visible. Off = held art stays solid (no dip).[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT switches it. Default: Keep

item.label: Background art crossfade
item.property: Crossfade time of the section background art while the Main menu is open (art advancing behind the strip). With the menu closed the art still cuts instantly.[CR][CR]Range: 0 s to 5 s Default: B Hex ghosts

item.label: Background dim level
item.property: How bright the section behind the Main menu stays while the menu is open (100% = no dim). Separate from LOOK > Global dimmer, which applies when the menu is closed.[CR][CR]Range: 5% to 100% Default: 10%

item.label: MM debug log
item.property: fork.3 debug: ON writes BEZEL DBGMM lines (warm start / done, timings) to kodi.log.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT switches it.

item.label: Dump MM state
item.property: fork.3 debug: OK writes the Main Menu state (bz_nav, bz_mmwarm, bz_xfade, bz_mmpick, bz_mmlock, path) to kodi.log once.

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_autoadv] AUTO SCROLL SYSTEM
item.property: Auto-advance of the section art behind the Main menu: on/off, how often, and the first hold. OK opens / closes this group.

item.label: Auto-advance under menu
item.property: ON = while the Main menu is open over a list, the list behind quietly steps to the next item so the fanart / poster changes. Close the menu or Select and you land on that item.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default: 100%

item.label: Auto-advance every
item.property: Seconds between steps of the list behind the Main menu.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK changes it. 4 to 30 s Default: 100%

item.label: Auto-advance first hold
item.property: Seconds the list behind waits after the Main menu opens before the first step.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK changes it. 2 to 60 s Default: 100%

item.label: Preset
item.property: Sets every slide menu setting at once: Default, Subtle, Mid, High or Extreme. Custom = you changed one by hand.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT cycles the presets.

item.label: Open speed
item.property: How fast the slide menu drops down from the top (also the view options slide-in, 4.0.1) of the block.[CR][CR]Higher = faster drop (1x = 0.4 s).[CR][CR]Range: 1x to 3x Default: 1x

item.label: Close speed
item.property: How fast the slide menu folds back up (also the view options slide-out).[CR][CR]Higher = faster close (1x = 0.35 s).[CR][CR]Range: 1x to 3x Default: 1x

item.label: Startup highlight
item.property: Which Main menu button is highlighted when Kodi starts.[CR][CR]MUSIC · MOVIES · TV SHOWS (default TV SHOWS).[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT switches it.

item.label: Double-tap window
item.property: Time allowed between two Select presses to count as a double tap (opens the menu).[CR][CR]Higher = easier double taps, but a single Select waits a little longer.[CR][CR]Range: 200 ms to 500 ms Default: 300 ms

item.label: Double-tap Select = menu
item.property: Double-tap Select anywhere in a list to open the menu.[CR][CR]OFF = open the menu only with Left / Back / M.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it.

item.label: Reset main menu
item.property: OK puts these settings back to their defaults.

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_music] MUSIC
item.property: Settings for music. OK opens / closes this section.

item.label: Preset
item.property: Sets every music setting at once: Default, Subtle, Mid, High or Extreme. Custom = you changed one by hand.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT cycles the presets.

item.label: Controls fade speed
item.property: Fade speed of the Now Playing controls.[CR][CR]Higher = faster fade in and out.[CR][CR]Range: 1x to 3x Default: 0.4x

item.label: Auto fullscreen music
item.property: Opens fullscreen music by itself after music starts.[CR][CR]The delay counts from the moment playback starts; it opens once per play session, only on the music screen with no menu or dialog up.[CR][CR]Steps: Off, 5 s, 10 s, 20 s, 30 s, 60 s Default: Off

item.label: Reset music
item.property: OK puts these settings back to their defaults.

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_dust] AMBIENT DUST
item.property: Settings for dust. OK opens / closes this section.

item.label: Preset
item.property: Sets every dust setting at once: Default, Subtle, Mid, High or Extreme. Custom = you changed one by hand.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT cycles the presets.

item.label: All dust
item.property: Master switch for every dust layer: main dust, soft dust, lit / album dust and the spin layer.[CR][CR]ON = the dust layers follow their own rows. OFF switches them all off at once.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default ON

item.label: Dust
item.property: The floating dust in the void around the block.[CR][CR]ON shows the dust, OFF removes every layer.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it.

item.label: Ambient dust
item.property: Ambient dust: the floating specks in the void that are NOT lit by the artwork - Distant, Mid and Ambient spin layers.[CR][CR]ON = the ambient layers follow their own rows. OFF hides all ambient dust and leaves only the lit dust.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default: OFF

item.label: Ambient position
item.property: Section open: ambient dust (Distant / Mid / Ambient spin) draws ABOVE the section parent group, or directly BEHIND it (shows in the gaps, hidden behind art / lists).

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_d20far] DISTANT DUST
item.property: Distant (far) ambient dust: fine specks and fiber streaks sliding slowly back and forth. OK opens / closes this group.

item.label: Distant dust
item.property: The farthest, faintest drift of dust (layer 1 in the diagram).[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default ON

item.label: Density
item.property: How many specks the Distant layer has.[CR][CR]Range: Low to High Default: Med

item.label: Size
item.property: How big the specks look in this layer (scales the approved layer texture).[CR][CR]Range: 90% to 125% Default: 90%

item.label: Opacity
item.property: Brightness (opacity) of the Distant layer. The particle brightness itself is baked into the texture.[CR][CR]Range: 10% to 100% Default: 60%

item.label: Fade speed
item.property: Speed of the looping fade of the Distant layer (runs opposite to Mid).[CR][CR]Range: Off to Faster Default: Mid

item.label: Slide speed
item.property: Speed of the slow back-and-forth slide of the Distant layer (opposite direction to Mid).[CR][CR]Range: Off to Faster Default: Fast

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_d20mid] MID DUST
item.property: Mid ambient dust: standard specks and fibers sliding the other way to Distant. OK opens / closes this group.

item.label: Mid dust
item.property: The middle drift of dust (layer 2).[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default ON

item.label: Density
item.property: How many specks the Mid layer has.[CR][CR]Range: Low to High Default: Low

item.label: Size
item.property: How big the specks look in this layer (scales the approved layer texture).[CR][CR]Range: 90% to 125% Default: 90%

item.label: Opacity
item.property: Brightness (opacity) of the Mid layer. The particle brightness itself is baked into the texture.[CR][CR]Range: 10% to 100% Default: 60%

item.label: Fade speed
item.property: Speed of the looping fade of the Mid layer (runs opposite to Distant).[CR][CR]Range: Off to Faster Default: Slow

item.label: Slide speed
item.property: Speed of the slow back-and-forth slide of the Mid layer (opposite direction to Distant).[CR][CR]Range: Off to Faster Default: Slow

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_d20spin] AMBIENT SPIN
item.property: Ambient spin: a full-screen ambient dust layer that only turns. OK opens / closes this group.

item.label: Ambient spin
item.property: An extra layer of crisp specks (with fibers and flakes) that slowly turns around the middle of the screen. It glows with the other ambient layers.[CR][CR]ON = slow turning haze. OFF = the drifting layers only.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it.

item.label: Density
item.property: How many specks the Ambient spin layer has.[CR][CR]Range: Low to High Default: Med

item.label: Size
item.property: How big the specks look in this layer (scales the approved layer texture).[CR][CR]Range: 90% to 125% Default: 100%

item.label: Opacity
item.property: Brightness (opacity) of the Ambient spin layer.[CR][CR]Range: 10% to 100% Default: 70%

item.label: Fade speed
item.property: Speed of the looping fade of the Ambient spin layer.[CR][CR]Range: Off to Faster Default: Slow

item.label: Spin speed
item.property: How long the spin layer takes for one full turn.[CR][CR]Lower = faster turning.[CR][CR]Range: 30 s to 600 s (10 s steps to 180 s, then 30 s) Default: 180 s

item.label: Spin direction
item.property: Which way the spin layer turns.[CR][CR]CW = clockwise. CCW = anticlockwise.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default: CCW

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_d20poster] POSTER DUST
item.property: Lit dust in the movie / TV poster glare. OK opens / closes this group.

item.label: Poster lit dust
item.property: Lit dust in the glare of movie / TV posters, separate from the album lit dust.[CR][CR]OFF = no lit dust on posters (albums keep theirs).[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default: ON

item.label: Poster lit dust Version
item.property: V1.0 = Dust 1.0 lit specks (default). V2.0 = the Dust 2.0 lit bake (poster textures, own set).[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it.

item.label: Poster lit dust opacity
item.property: Brightness of the lit dust in the light beam during the hold.[CR][CR]Higher = brighter lit specks on the glare side.[CR][CR]Range: 10% to 100% Default: 70%

item.label: Lit particle size
item.property: Size of the lit specks: the glare dust, the lit spin and the spin layer.[CR][CR]Small = finer specks. Large = bigger, softer specks.[CR][CR]Range: Small to Large Default: Small

item.label: Lit spin
item.property: A slow turning layer of lit specks inside the glare band of the poster / album. It follows the art sway.[CR][CR]ON = turning lit specks in the glare. OFF = drifting lit dust only.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default: ON

item.label: Lit spin speed
item.property: How long the lit spin takes for one full turn.[CR][CR]Lower = faster turning.[CR][CR]Range: 30 s to 600 s (10 s steps to 180 s, then 30 s) Default: 240 s

item.label: Lit spin direction
item.property: Which way the lit spin turns.[CR][CR]CW = clockwise. CCW = anticlockwise.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default: CCW (opposite of the spin layer)

item.label: Lit mix fibers
item.property: Fine curled fibers that turn with the spin layer.[CR][CR]ON = a few thin strands in the spin. OFF = specks only.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default: OFF

item.label: Fiber amount
item.property: How many fibers turn in the spin layer.[CR][CR]Rare = a handful, More = clearly visible strands.[CR][CR]Range: Rare to More Default: Rare

item.label: Lit mix flakes
item.property: Small irregular flakes (some with a bright facet) that turn with the spin layer.[CR][CR]ON = flakes mixed into the specks. OFF = specks only.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default: OFF

item.label: Flake amount
item.property: How many flakes turn in the spin layer.[CR][CR]Range: Low to High Default: Low

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_d20album] ALBUM DUST
item.property: Lit dust in the album glare (both sway ends, full mix). OK opens / closes this group.

item.label: Album lit dust
item.property: Lit dust (separate from ambient dust): specks that light up in the glare during the hold.[CR][CR]ON = lit specks through the glare. OFF = ambient dust only.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it.

item.label: Album lit dust Version
item.property: V1.0 = Dust 1.0 lit specks (default). V2.0 = the Dust 2.0 lit bake (album textures, own set).[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it.

item.label: Album lit dust opacity
item.property: Brightness of the lit dust in the light beam during the hold.[CR][CR]Higher = brighter lit specks on the glare side.[CR][CR]Range: 10% to 100% Default: 60%

item.label: Lit particle size
item.property: Size of the lit specks: the glare dust, the lit spin and the spin layer.[CR][CR]Small = finer specks. Large = bigger, softer specks.[CR][CR]Range: Small to Large Default: Small

item.label: Lit spin
item.property: A slow turning layer of lit specks inside the glare band of the poster / album. It follows the art sway.[CR][CR]ON = turning lit specks in the glare. OFF = drifting lit dust only.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default: ON

item.label: Lit spin speed
item.property: How long the lit spin takes for one full turn.[CR][CR]Lower = faster turning.[CR][CR]Range: 30 s to 600 s (10 s steps to 180 s, then 30 s) Default: 120 s

item.label: Lit spin direction
item.property: Which way the lit spin turns.[CR][CR]CW = clockwise. CCW = anticlockwise.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default: CCW (opposite of the spin layer)

item.label: Lit mix fibers
item.property: Fine curled fibers that turn with the spin layer.[CR][CR]ON = a few thin strands in the spin. OFF = specks only.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default: ON

item.label: Fiber amount
item.property: How many fibers turn in the spin layer.[CR][CR]Rare = a handful, More = clearly visible strands.[CR][CR]Range: Rare to More Default: Rare

item.label: Lit mix flakes
item.property: Small irregular flakes (some with a bright facet) that turn with the spin layer.[CR][CR]ON = flakes mixed into the specks. OFF = specks only.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default: OFF

item.label: Flake amount
item.property: How many flakes turn in the spin layer.[CR][CR]Range: Low to High Default: Low

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_d20menu] MENU DUST
item.property: Lit dust on top of the glow behind the Main menu strip (album lit textures). OK opens / closes this group.

item.label: Menu dust
item.property: Lit dust floating in the colour-strip glow behind the Main menu. Own textures and settings, separate from the album / poster lit dust.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default: ON

item.label: Opacity
item.property: Opacity of the Main menu dust layer (colordiffuse on the strip glow dust).[CR][CR]Range: 10% to 100% Default: 60%

item.label: Size
item.property: How big the specks look in this layer (scales the approved layer texture).[CR][CR]Range: 90% to 125% Default: 90%

item.label: Fade speed
item.property: Speed of the looping fade of the Main menu dust.[CR][CR]Range: Off to Faster Default: Mid

item.label: Slide speed
item.property: Speed of the slow drift / sway of the Main menu dust.[CR][CR]Range: Off to Faster Default: Mid

item.label: Reset dust
item.property: OK puts these settings back to their defaults.

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_look] LOOK
item.property: Settings for look. OK opens / closes this section.

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_colourblock] COLOUR BLOCK
item.property: Settings for colour block. OK opens / closes this group.

item.label: Colour
item.property: Colour of the BEZEL colour block behind the list, menu and pop-ups.[CR][CR]Pick a preset; Custom colours come from Skin Settings.[CR][CR]Range: BEZEL blue to Teal Default: Red

item.label: Opacity
item.property: How solid the colour block is.[CR][CR]Higher = more solid colour. Lower = more of the backdrop shows through.[CR][CR]Range: 50% to 100% Default: 60%

item.label: Reset colour block
item.property: OK puts these settings back to their defaults.

item.label: Backdrop image
item.property: Which texture fills the color block behind the list (files in extras/backdrop).[CR][CR]Random = a new one on every window load. Pick a file and it stays until you change it.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT cycles: Random, then each image. Default: Random[CR]Strength: Skin Settings > Backdrop Opacity.

item.label: Global dimmer
item.property: How dark every section (Music, Videos: their parent groups) gets behind the Main menu. Replaces MAIN MENU > Section dim.[CR][CR]Range: 30% to 100% Default: 100%

item.label: Backdrop style
item.property: Corner-key light beam behind every window (Home, sections, fullscreen), aimed at the big album. OFF = plain black.[CR][CR]Options: Off, Corner Key Default: Corner Key

item.label: Backdrop opacity
item.property: How strong the backdrop beam shows.[CR][CR]Range: 20% to 100% Default: 60%

item.label: Backdrop colour
item.property: Tint of the backdrop beam. Strip = follows the colour strip.[CR][CR]Options: Warm, White, Amber, Teal, Rose, Strip Default: Warm

item.label: Fanart opacity
item.property: Opacity of the background fanart in every section (Music, Videos, lists, info). Bar opacity is separate.[CR][CR]Range: 0% to 100% (10% steps) Default: 100%

item.label: Now-playing music label
item.property: ON = while music plays, the song title / artist / time line shows at the top right of the screen. OFF = hidden.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default: 100%

item.label: Bar style
item.property: Focus bar style for every BEZEL list and the Main menu.[CR][CR]Square, rounded, pill, underline or outline.[CR][CR]Range: Square to Outline Default: Outline

item.label: BEZEL logo colour
item.property: Colour of the BEZEL logo (Main menu Settings button, busy spinner logo).[CR][CR]Range: White, Silver, Amber, Orange, Red, Green, BEZEL blue, Purple Default: White

item.label: BEZEL logo opacity
item.property: How solid the BEZEL logo is.[CR][CR]Higher = brighter. Lower = more see-through.[CR][CR]Range: 30% to 100% Default: White

item.label: Reset look
item.property: OK puts these settings back to their defaults.

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_fsmusic] FULLSCREEN MUSIC
item.property: Chrome over Fullscreen Music 1 and 2 (and the visualizer): title / artist / album, progress + time, mode pill, LAST / NEXT transport bar. Bio and lyrics text are not chrome. OK opens / closes this section.

item.label: Dialogue FS
item.property: 5.33.64: Fullscreen Music look.[CR][CR]BIG ALBUM = current view. DIALOGUE FS = previous / now / next albums side by side, Now Playing bar under the centre.[CR][CR]OK switches it. Default: BIG ALBUM

item.label: $VAR[BzTSec_fs_overlay] OVERLAY
item.property: Chrome colour / opacity, title / artist / album, progress + time, cycle pill, transport bar. OK opens / closes this group.

item.label: Chrome opacity
item.property: How solid all the Fullscreen Music chrome is (FS1, FS2, visualizer).[CR][CR]Range: 0% to 100% (10% steps) Default: 40%

item.label: Chrome colour
item.property: Colour of all the Fullscreen Music chrome.[CR][CR]White, Warm, Cool, Gold, Rose, Accent Default: White

item.label: Title / artist / album
item.property: Song title, artist and album text at the top of the block.[CR][CR]ON = show. OFF = hide.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default: ON

item.label: Title / artist / album size
item.property: Text size for the song title, artist and album together. Lines stay bottom-aligned above the progress bar.[CR][CR]Range: 90% to 125% Default: 100%

item.label: Drop shadow
item.property: 5.33.57: Drop shadow pill. Drop shadow behind the Overlay text and transport (and every label sharing that shadow).[CR][CR]ON = shadow, using the angle / opacity / distance / blur / tint / mix settings below. OFF = no shadow.[CR][CR]OK = pill on / off (OFF fully removes the shadow in Fullscreen Music). LEFT = off, RIGHT = on. Default: OFF (5.33.84 t535)

item.label: Shadow angle
item.property: Direction of the drop shadow on Overlay elements.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT cycles: DOWN-RIGHT, DOWN, DOWN-LEFT, RIGHT. Default: DOWN-RIGHT

item.label: Shadow opacity
item.property: How dark the drop shadow on Overlay elements is.[CR][CR]Range: 10% to 100% Default: 50%

item.label: Shadow distance
item.property: How far the drop shadow sits from Overlay elements.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT steps: NEAR 2px, MEDIUM 4px, FAR 8px, FARTHER 14px, MAX 22px. Default: MEDIUM[CR]Works with Shadow angle + opacity.

item.label: Shadow blur strength
item.property: How wide the soft shadow spreads (outer ring distance). TIGHT 2px, SOFT 4px, WIDE 7px, HUGE 11px. Default: SOFT[CR]LEFT / RIGHT steps. Picture on the right follows.

item.label: Shadow colour tint
item.property: Colour of the drop shadow. BLACK, BLUE, PURPLE, WARM, RED. Default: BLACK[CR]LEFT / RIGHT steps. Picture on the right follows.

item.label: Shadow soft / hard mix
item.property: Soft vs hard. SOFT = faint wide edge, BALANCED = firmer core, HARD = crisp single shadow. Default: SOFT[CR]LEFT / RIGHT steps. Picture on the right follows.

item.label: Progress + time
item.property: Progress line and elapsed / total time under the titles.[CR][CR]ON = show. OFF = hide.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default: ON

item.label: Cycle pill
item.property: Mode pill top right (cycles Visualizer / Bio / Fanart / Lyrics / Up Next / Controls). OFF only fades it out; it still takes focus and works.[CR][CR]ON = show. OFF = hide.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default: ON

item.label: Transport bar
item.property: Bottom row: last / next song title pills, LAST / NEXT labels, arrows and play / pause icon. One toggle for the whole row.[CR][CR]ON = show. OFF = hide.[CR][CR]LEFT / RIGHT or OK switches it. Default: ON

item.label: Reset chrome
item.property: OK puts these settings back to their defaults.

item.label: Fanart Pop
item.property: Subject-pop artist fanart in Fullscreen Music: a filled background plus the cut-out artist slightly larger on top.[CR][CR]Needs a fanart_pop folder (bg.png + fg.png) in the song folder or the artist folder. item.label: ALL
item.property: Settings for all. OK opens / closes this section.

item.label: Reset System
item.property: Reset system settings to defaults. OK opens Yes / No here in the Tuner — no popup.

item.label: Yes — reset system
item.property: Yes resets system settings to defaults (same as Reset system), then returns to the Tuner list.

item.label: No — cancel
item.property: Cancel and return to the Bezel Tuner list.

item.label: Reset all tuning
item.property: OK puts these settings back to their defaults.

item.label: Crash report
item.property: OK shows the latest Kodi crash log, kodi.log or the previous run log, copies the crash log to Kodi home, or opens the log uploader when it is installed.

item.label: Reset EVERYTHING
item.property: OK puts these settings back to their defaults.

item.label: Export tuning
item.property: OK saves your tuning to a file in the skin data folder.

item.label: Import tuning
item.property: OK loads a tuning file you exported earlier (bezel_tuning.json). Files from 4.0.0 are moved to the new finer steps, so every speed stays the same.

item.label: Delete BEZEL settings
item.property: OK deletes all BEZEL skin settings on this device (settings.xml, Tuner exports, bezel_cw helpers), then reloads BEZEL clean. Cannot be undone.
